scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @emote/contracts && npm run build --workspace api && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace api && npm run lint --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace api -- --runInBand && npm run test:e2e --workspace api -- --runInBand
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @emote/contracts && npm exec --workspace web tsc -- -b && npm run build --workspace api
